Catalan

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Latin potentiālis.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • Audio (Barcelona):(file)

Adjective

[edit]

potencial m or f (masculine and feminine plural potencials)

  1. potential

Derived terms

[edit]
  • potencialment

Related terms

[edit]
  • potència

Further reading

[edit]
  • “potencial”, in Diccionari de la llengua catalana [Dictionary of the Catalan Language] (in Catalan), second edition, Institute of Catalan Studies [Catalan: Institut d'Estudis Catalans], April 2007
  • “potencial”, in Gran Diccionari de la Llengua Catalana, Grup Enciclopèdia Catalana, 2026
  • “potencial” in Diccionari normatiu valencià, Acadèmia Valenciana de la Llengua.
  • “potencial” in Diccionari català-valencià-balear, Antoni Maria Alcover and Francesc de Borja Moll, 1962.

Portuguese

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Latin potentiālis.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /po.tẽ.siˈaw/ [po.tẽ.sɪˈaʊ̯], (faster pronunciation) /po.tẽˈsjaw/ [po.tẽˈsjaʊ̯]
 
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /pu.tẽˈsjal/ [pu.tẽˈsjaɫ]
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /pu.tẽˈsjal/ [pu.tẽˈsjaɫ]
    • (Southern Portugal) IPA(key): /pu.tẽˈsja.li/

  • Rhymes: -al, -aw
  • Hyphenation: po‧ten‧ci‧al

Adjective

[edit]

potencial m or f (plural potenciais)

  1. potential
  2. virtual
  3. possible

Derived terms

[edit]
  • potencialmente

Noun

[edit]

potencial m (plural potenciais)

  1. potential
  2. pressure

Further reading

[edit]
  • “potencial”, in Dicionário Aulete Digital (in Portuguese), Rio de Janeiro: Lexikon Editora Digital, 2008–2026
  • “potencial”, in Dicionário Priberam da Língua Portuguesa (in Portuguese), Lisbon: Priberam, 2008–2026

Spanish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Late Latin potentiālis.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /potenˈθjal/ [po.t̪ẽn̟ˈθjal] (Spain, Equatorial Guinea)
  • IPA(key): /potenˈsjal/ [po.t̪ẽnˈsjal] (Latin America, Philippines)
  • Rhymes: -al
  • Syllabification: po‧ten‧cial

Adjective

[edit]

potencial m or f (masculine and feminine plural potenciales)

  1. potential

Noun

[edit]

potencial m (plural potenciales)

  1. potential
    Synonym: porvenir
  2. (grammar) conditional tense
    Synonym: condicional

Derived terms

[edit]
  • energía potencial
  • potencial de acción
  • potencialmente

Further reading

[edit]
  • “potencial”, in Diccionario de la lengua española [Dictionary of the Spanish Language] (in Spanish), online version 23.8.1, Royal Spanish Academy [Spanish: Real Academia Española], 15 December 2025
